title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Software Engineer (LAMP / Angular / JavaScript)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of development experience solving complex technical problems across front-end, back-end, and full-stack technologies, including Angular, to join our U.S. client. The ideal candidate should have experience in server-side logic development, defining and maintaining central databases, and ensuring high performance and request responsiveness. The role will involve transforming UI / UX designs into functional HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (including Angular). The primary application stack is LAMP, comprising the latest versions of PHP, MySQL, and Linux, along with Angular for front-end development. You will also be responsible for integrating Angular components built by co-workers into the application.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System that integrates booking, guest communications, and financial reporting, all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Build efficient, testable, and reusable PHP or JavaScript modules
  • Identify solutions to complex problems
  • Solve performance issues and architectural challenges
  • Integrate data storage solutions like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB
  • Ensure that the code that you produce passes the SonarCloud quality rules for each pull request
  • Integrate user-facing elements developed by front-end developers, including Angular components
  • Translate UI / UX designs and convert them into working HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, including Angular
  • Analyze, configure, and tune the front-end web application, including Angular performance optimization
  • Be a subject matter expert on web technologies, including Angular
  • Enforce software development standards and mentor junior engineers in Angular development best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in web application development using Angular
  • Strong knowledge of PHP web frameworks and libraries (e.g., Zend Framework, Laminas, Laravel, Symphony, and Doctrine)
  • Understanding of MVC design patterns, front-end technologies (e.g., JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and Angular), accessibility and security compliance, scalable application design principles (including Angular architecture and scalability considerations), and user authentication and authorization across multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases and their declarative query languages
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git and GitHub
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Familiarity with code review and analysis tools, such as SonarCloud
  • Experience with AWS
  • Knowledge of AI toolsets and toolkits


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Consultor(a) de Comunicação Interna (Eventos e Comunidade)
description:
A Screencorp é especialista em soluções de Comunicação Interna para aproximar empresas e colaboradores.


Nossa missão é ajudar empresas a se comunicarem melhor com seus colaboradores, fornecendo tecnologia relevante e contextualizada com o objetivo de aumentar engajamento e estabelecer um propósito compartilhado de trabalho.

O Desafio

Você será a \"cara\" da Screencorp para o mercado e para nossa base de clientes.

Seu papel é híbrido: você atuará na educação do mercado através de eventos, no fortalecimento da nossa rede de contatos em RH e na identificação de oportunidades estratégicas dentro dos clientes que já confiam na nossa marca.


Suas Principais Missões:
  • Gestão de Experiências: Planejar e executar o calendário de eventos (webinars, meetups remotos e eventos presenciais de networking) focados em tendências de CI e RH.
  • Fortalecimento de Comunidade: Atuar ativamente em grupos, associações e comunidades de RH/Comunicação para posicionar a Screencorp como autoridade no setor.
  • Faro de Negócios (Growth na Base): Atuar consultivamente com nossos clientes atuais para entender suas dores e identificar momentos ideais para ofertas de upsell (upgrade de plano) ou cross-sell (adoção de novos produtos do ecossistema Screencorp).
  • Embaixador(a) da Marca: Representar a empresa em feiras, congressos e entrevistas para a mídia, disseminando nossa cultura e visão sobre o futuro do trabalho.
  • Produção de Conteúdo Estratégico: Apoiar o time de marketing com insights vindos diretamente da comunidade para a criação de materiais que ajudem na conversão.

    • O que buscamos:
    • Formação em Comunicação Social, Relações Públicas, Jornalismo ou Marketing.
    • Experiência prévia com Organização de Eventos (do planejamento à execução).
    • Perfil \"Hunter\" de Relacionamento: alguém que sinta facilidade em abordar pessoas e construir pontes (Networking).
    • Visão de Negócios: entender que a comunicação deve estar alinhada aos KPIs de vendas e retenção.
    • Excelente oratória e desenvoltura para falar em público e em vídeos.
    • Desejável: Conhecimento prévio do mercado de SaaS ou vivência em RH/Endomarketing.


    Soft Skills que valorizamos:
    • Atitude de Dono: você encara cada evento como um projeto pessoal, agindo com autonomia e proatividade para superar as expectativas.
    • Escuta Ativa: essencial para identificar oportunidades de vendas de forma consultiva e natural.
    • Resiliência: para lidar com a dinâmica de eventos e negociações.
    O que oferecemos:
    • 100% Home Office (não iremos voltar ao presencial)
    • Ambiente respeitoso, informal e pragmático
    • Auxílio Home office
    • Flash Benefícios
    • Plano de saúde Sulamérica
    • Folga no aniversário
    • Enviamos os equipamentos eletrônicos necessários para seu trabalho
    • Contratação CLT

title: Customer Success Consultant
description:
Customer Success & Business Development Consultant – Latin America

CAS uses intuitive technology, unparalleled scientific content, and unmatched human expertise to help companies create groundbreaking innovations that benefit the world. As the scientific information solutions division of the American Chemical Society, CAS manages the largest curated reservoir of scientific knowledge and, for over 115 years, has helped innovators mine, assess, and apply that information to keep businesses thriving. The CAS team is global, diverse, endlessly curious, and strives to make scientific insights accessible to innovators worldwide.


CAS is seeking an independent consultant to support delivering services that combine customer success expertise with business development activities, focusing on consultative engagement, solution-oriented selling, and collaborative account management.


Key Deliveries include:

Customer Success & Engagement

  • Facilitate onboarding and enablement sessions for CAS users.
  • Provide guidance to help customers realize the full value of CAS solutions.
  • Maintain strong relationships across multiple levels within client organizations.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities to grow, retain, and cross-sell within existing accounts.
  • Develop a pipeline of new business opportunities in the assigned territory.
  • Conduct prospecting activities, including calls, emails, and presentations.

Strategic Communication

  • Deliver compelling presentations and messaging to build awareness of CAS solutions.
  • Support marketing activities such as workshops, seminars, and industry events.
  • Represent CAS at conferences and trade shows as agreed.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate records of activities and opportunities in CRM (Salesforce/LEX).
  • Provide regular progress updates on engagement metrics and deliverables.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science-related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in sales, account management, customer success, and business development.
  • English fluency (written and spoken); Portuguese required; Spanish is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce/LEX) and virtual meeting tools (Teams, Zoom, WebEx).
  • Dynamic, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).


Required Expertise:

  • Proven success in solution-based sales and consultative engagement.
  • Strong ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable insights.
  • Skilled in relationship building across organizational levels.
  • Familiarity with scientific information tools and intellectual property solutions (preferred).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


Location & Travel

Based in Brazil; with regional travel within Brazil and across Latin America required up to 20% of the time.


This is an independent consulting engagement. The consultant will be responsible for all taxes, insurance, and business expenses. Duration, deliverables, and compensation will be agreed upon in the consulting contract.


To apply for this consulting position, please submit your cover letter and CV to

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer (JavaScript, PHP, linux)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on linux, nginx (engine x), fpm and mostly mysql
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best-practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to be sure to achieve deadlines with high quality
  • Team player with effective communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


Preferred experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka \"Engine X\")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.

Skyhouse Agency is a performance marketing agency seeking an Entry-Level Account Manager to support day-to-day client operations and internal coordination. • Collaborative, execution-focused culture with strong mentorship

• Opportunity to grow into senior performance or team leadership roles

title: Senior Software Developer - React Native
description:
Project Description:

Our Client is one of largest TV providers in North America and we are searching for a Senior Software Developer to join our team. The project focuses on developing mobile application for video streaming platform.


Responsibilities:

You will be implementing new features and enhancing existing functionalities on client applications to support streaming video products. This includes estimation, design, development, testing, and documentation.

Collaborate with other software engineers, product managers, and architects in a cross functional environment to ensure functions and performance meet customer requirements in a cost effective and maintainable way.

Provide on-call support including monitoring, triaging and resolving production issues


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • - Proficient in JavaScript and React Native mobile app development (5+ years) as well as at least one of the following: Java/Kotlin or Obj-C/Swift
  • - Streaming mobile app development experience with iOS/Android and TV Platforms
  • - Strong teamwork focus and the ability to foster collaboration within and across teams
  • - Experience with agile development
  • - Good verbal/written communications skills


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Mobile III (PLENO)
description:
Quem é Stone Tech?

A Stone nasceu com o propósito de ser protagonista na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, lutando para oferecer as melhores soluções para quem empreende no Brasil.

Pensando nisso, construímos a Stone Tech! A junção dos times de tecnologia Stone Co. e as empresas financeiras do grupo que reconhecem o potencial empreendedor de cada brasileiro. Por aqui, temos todas as inovações e tecnologias de ponta da Stone, Pagar.me, Ton e Vitta, com uma galera referência no mercado de tecnologia, em um ambiente descontraído, repleto de desafios, oportunidades, flexibilidade, teamplay e desenvolvimento contínuo.

Nossa cultura:

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).
  • Procurement/Purchasing Experience +5 years
  • Contract negotiations.
  • Customer service minded.



Skills & Knowledge

Strong Negotiation and commercial contracting skills specially in professional services,

facilities and maintenance (MRO).

• Use of computer tools such as Microsoft Excel, Coupa, CLMs.

• Knowledge of plant operations preferred.

• This role demands continuous interaction with key stakeholders within Brambles Supply

Chain and Corporate Business.

• Data Analytics (Intermediate level Excel to include Pivot tables, formulas, etc.) with

development potential.

title: Desenvolvedor Java Pleno (Fiscal)
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.



Principais Responsabilidades:


- Análise, design e codificação de aplicativos voltados para entrega de obrigações fiscais, tais como: NF-e, CT-e, NFS-e, MDF-e, Reinf, etc.

- Participação ativa no ciclo de desenvolvimento, trabalhando com dinâmicas ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, inclusive com interfaces em times com diferentes tecnologias.

- Atuar integrado ao time, mantendo a aplicação como full-cycle, sendo responsável desde o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades a resolução de problemas em ambientes produtivos.

- Colaboração ativa com stakeholders internos e externos.

- Atuar com foco nos clientes para entender os requisitos do negócio e buscar liberações de valor.

- Participação ativa na manutenção das práticas, padrões e processos que permeiam os padrões de desenvolvimento e qualidade.

- Ser referência no apoio técnico aos recursos de menos senioridade, sempre validando os padrões com a gestão.




Requisitos Necessários:


- Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlacionadas.

- Experiência comprovada de 5 anos ou mais no desenvolvimento de aplicações em Java 11 (ou superior);

- Certificações em JAVA são considerados diferenciais;

- Experiencia em Jasper é considerado diferencial;

- Experiência com Integração de sistemas (SOAP, REST);

- Experiência com SQL (JDBC);

- Experiência com Git;

- Familiaridade com frameworks e métodos ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban.

- Boa comunicação, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e habilidades de resolução de problemas;

- Desejável conhecimento de ferramentas da Atlassian (Jira, Bitbucket, Confluence);

- Inglês Avançado (diferencial);


CLT

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Social Seller
description:
OPORTUNIDADE: SOCIAL SELLER (Remoto)


Transforme conexões em vendas reais no mercado digital

Você é apaixonado por redes sociais, sabe se conectar com pessoas de forma genuína e possui habilidade para transformar conversas em vendas?

Busca crescimento rápido, gosta de desafios e quer atuar ao lado de grandes experts do mercado digital?

Então essa vaga é para você.



Sobre a RedSuit

Na RedSuit, acreditamos que toda venda começa com um relacionamento verdadeiro.

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

Somos especialistas em potencializar resultados por meio de estratégias modernas de Social Selling — e agora buscamos alguém com energia, foco e vontade de crescer para integrar nosso time.


O que faz um Social Seller?

O Social Seller é responsável por conduzir vendas sociais por meio de interações estratégicas nas redes (Instagram, LinkedIn e outros canais).

Na prática, você atuará como um “clone digital” do expert, construindo relações, nutrindo leads e convertendo seguidores em clientes.


Responsabilidades Principais
  • Dar boas-vindas e engajar novos seguidores via Direct do Instagram
  • Construir e nutrir relacionamentos com leads qualificados
  • Fechar vendas diretamente ou agendar reuniões para Closers/Experts
  • Registrar e acompanhar todas as interações no CRM (Kommo)
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos para maximizar conversões
  • Gerar relatórios diários de performance e indicadores
  • Participar de reuniões de alinhamento e estratégia



O que esperamos de você
  • Experiência prévia em vendas — preferencialmente no digital (infoprodutos, mentorias, lançamentos)
  • Excelente comunicação: clara, empática e persuasiva
  • Organização e disciplina para gerenciar múltiplos leads simultaneamente
  • Foco em metas, mentalidade de crescimento e resiliência
  • Equipamentos adequados para trabalho remoto (PC/Laptop + celular)



O que oferecemos

Salário fixo + comissões agressivas (ganhe proporcional à sua performance)

Treinamento personalizado com nosso Head de Vendas

title: Brazil - Remote: Back-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.


Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency.
  • Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems.
  • Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets.

What You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models.
  • System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems.
  • Rapid Delivery: Adopt a \"deliver fast\" mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards.

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Streaming & High-Throughput Data

  • Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time.
  • Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings.

GenAI & Autonomous Agents

  • Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating.
  • Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers

Graph & Knowledge Engineering

  • Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data.
  • Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal.


Qualifications

Must Haves:

  • Complete Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related.
  • 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development.
  • Advanced English communication skills.
  • Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms.
  • Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI).

Good to Have:

  • Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB).
  • GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases.
  • Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies
  • Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA).
  • Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments.
  • Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes.
  • Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data.
  • GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs.
  • Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search).

Desired Profile

  • Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph.
  • Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable.
  • You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency.

Fully remote position.

Requisition Number:

Product Service Line: Landmark Software & Services

Full Time / Part Time: Full Time

title: Backend Developer - Node.js
description:
Job Description


We are looking for a Back-end Developer to work on the development and evolution of back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS. The professional will be responsible for building scalable solutions, maintaining engineering best practices, contributing to technical decisions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a dynamic and agile environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end applications using Node.js and NestJS .
  • Ensure clean, scalable, and well-documented code.


Data Management

  • Implement and manage relational databases (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational databases (MongoDB ).
  • Optimize queries and ensure data integrity.


Version Control

  • Use Git for version control, maintaining code history and integrity.
  • Collaborate through pull requests and code reviews.


Agile Methodologies

  • Actively participate in sprints , plannings, and other agile ceremonies.
  • Adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.


Quality & Automation

  • Write automated tests to guarantee quality and stability.
  • Use CI/CD tools to support continuous integration and delivery.


Communication & Teamwork

  • Collaborate with multifunctional teams (product, design, QA, front‑end).
  • Communicate requirements and delivery status clearly.


Nice-to-Have Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable microservices and RESTful APIs .
  • Configure and manage containers using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Deploy and manage applications on cloud providers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud ).


Requirements


  • Proficiency in Node.js and NestJS .
  • Strong knowledge of relational (PostgreSQL ) and non-relational (MongoDB ) databases.
  • Experience with version control using Git .
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban ).
  • Ability to write clean, scalable, and well-structured code.
  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD tools.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.


Differential Competencies

  • Experience with microservices architecture .
  • Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Experience with cloud services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

title: Estagio - Devops
description:
A DreamSquad é uma boutique especializada em Cloud Computing , atuando com clientes de diferentes segmentos e portes. Nossos projetos são focados em: Excelência operacional, Segurança e confiabilidade, Alta performance, Otimização de custos E Sustentabilidade.

Estamos em constante crescimento e nos tornando uma referência no setor, elevando o padrão de qualidade das entregas.

Buscamos uma pessoa em início de carreira em Cloud/DevOps que queira aprender na prática, atuar em projetos reais e se desenvolver em um ambiente colaborativo e técnico.


Principais atividades

Você irá atuar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento e DevOps para:

  • Automatizar processos e rotinas operacionais.
  • Configurar e manter pipelines de CI/CD .
  • Apoiar na identificação e resolução de problemas de infraestrutura em nuvem.
  • Criar e manter monitoramento da camada sistêmica dos clientes.
  • Contribuir com documentação técnica e aprender continuamente sobre boas práticas de engenharia.


Requisitos

  • Conhecimentos básicos em DevOps e AWS .

title: Analista SAP  MM
description:
Vaga: Analista Funcional MM Pleno

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: 1 mes (com possibilidade de extensão)

Local de Trabalho: 100% remoto

Horário de Trabalho: 9h00 às 18h00


*** para esta atividade o profissional precisa estar 100% dedicado, não sendo possível atividades paralelas (o cliente poderá solicitar presença durante o periodo em sala virtual) ***


Resumo da posição


Buscamos um(a) Analista Funcional SAP MM Pleno para atuar em um projeto de retrofit envolvendo ambientes SAP ECC e SAP S/4HANA. O profissional terá atuação predominantemente analítica, apoiando a avaliação de impactos, mapeamento de processos e suporte funcional às frentes de adaptação e conversão, sem responsabilidade direta por desenvolvimento ou resolução técnica de incidentes complexos.


Principais responsabilidades


• Analisar processos de Materiais e Compras (SAP MM) existentes no ambiente ECC

• Apoiar a avaliação de impactos funcionais na transição/retrofit para SAP S/4HANA

• Realizar levantamento de requisitos junto às áreas de negócio

• Mapear gaps entre o cenário atual (ECC) e o modelo futuro (S/4HANA)

• Elaborar documentações funcionais (especificações, fluxos de processo, análises de impacto)

• Apoiar testes funcionais (unitários e integrados) relacionados às adaptações do retrofit

• Atuar como ponte entre áreas de negócio, consultores técnicos e demais frentes do projeto

• Contribuir com análises funcionais, sem atuação direta como responsável por correções técnicas ou desenvolvimentos


Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios


• Experiência como Analista Funcional SAP MM em nível Pleno

• Conhecimento dos principais processos do módulo MM:

• Procurement (requisição, pedido de compra, contratos)

• Gestão de estoque e movimentações de materiais

• Recebimento de mercadorias (GR) e verificação de faturas (MIRO)

• Avaliação de materiais e tipos de estoque

• Experiência prévia com SAP ECC

• Conhecimento funcional de SAP S/4HANA (mesmo que em projetos de transição, suporte ou rollout)

• Experiência em atividades de análise funcional, levantamento de requisitos e documentação


Requisitos desejáveis


• Experiência em projetos de conversão, migração ou retrofit para SAP S/4HANA

• Vivência em testes integrados e suporte a ciclos de UAT

• Conhecimento básico de integrações do MM com FI e SD

• Familiaridade com ferramentas de documentação e gestão de requisitos



Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante entrevista técnica com o cliente.

title: Senior SAP Consultant
description:
Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant (Remote, Brazil)


We are looking for a Senior SAP Fieldglass Consultant to join a global project, working 100 percent remotely from Brazil . This role is for someone with real hands on experience in SAP Fieldglass implementations , not generic SAP consulting.


If you have worked deeply with Fieldglass CWM and SOW , understand Source to Pay , and are comfortable working directly with clients, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Work on SAP Fieldglass implementation and rollout projects
  • Configure and support Contingent Workforce Management (CWM) and Statement of Work (SOW) processes
  • Collaborate with procurement, HR, finance, and IT stakeholders
  • Support integrations between SAP Fieldglass and SAP Ariba, SAP S 4HANA, or SAP ECC
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into Fieldglass configuration
  • Identify risks early and propose clear mitigation actions
  • Support testing, defect resolution, and UAT activities using JIRA
  • Ensure high quality delivery with strong focus on customer satisfaction

Mandatory Experience

  • 6 or more years of hands on experience with SAP Fieldglass
  • Proven experience in Fieldglass implementation or rollout projects
  • Strong configuration experience in CWM and SOW

title: Cloud Architecture Consultant (AWS – HIPAA)
description:
About You

You are a Cloud Architect who enjoys owning architectural decisions and designing secure, scalable, and compliant cloud solutions. You thrive in regulated environments and are comfortable balancing hands-on technical work with strategic thinking. You’re motivated by building robust AWS architectures that meet strict security and compliance requirements—especially in healthcare-related contexts—and by collaborating closely with engineering, security, and compliance teams to deliver reliable cloud platforms.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong professional experience as a Cloud Architect on AWS , owning end-to-end architectural decisions.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services , including Lightsail .
  • Experience working with cPanel-based environments hosted on AWS.
  • Solid knowledge of HIPAA compliance and proven experience designing and maintaining HIPAA-compliant cloud architectures on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management, encryption, network security, and data protection.
  • Experience implementing and reviewing security controls aligned with regulatory and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, security, and compliance teams.
  • Strong documentation skills for architecture designs, decisions, and compliance considerations.
  • Comfortable providing technical guidance and architectural leadership across teams.
  • Excellent English communication skills for working with US-based stakeholders.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement secure, scalable, and compliant AWS cloud architectures.
  • Build, maintain, and evolve HIPAA-compliant architectures, following AWS best practices and approved services.
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and compliance teams to ensure solutions meet regulatory and technical standards.
  • Define and enforce security controls, including encryption, access management, and network protections.
  • Review and optimize existing AWS environments for performance, reliability, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Document cloud architectures, technical decisions, and compliance-related considerations clearly and consistently.
  • Provide architectural leadership and technical guidance to development and infrastructure teams.
  • Support continuous improvement of cloud standards, patterns, and best practices across the organization.


Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Senior Software (TypeScript/Ruby/React) Engineer
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help shape and scale a modern web experience for a fast-paced, consumer-facing product team. You’ll work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver elegant, performant, and maintainable applications using TypeScript, Ruby on Rails and React . This role is ideal for someone who possesses a high level of agency, a \"doer\" mentality, and the ability to maintain a full product vision while shipping high-quality code at speed.


Core Requirements :

  • Mastery of TypeScript and React for building complex, scalable web applications.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development with a proven track record of shipping production-grade software.
  • Experience working with Ruby on Rails (or interest in a product where RoR is core)
  • Prior experience in the Trading, Brokerage, or Wealth Management industries.
  • Demonstrated high level of agency and a proactive \"doer\" mentality, with the ability to hit the ground running and own features end-to-end.
  • Strong product sense and the ability to build for the long term while balancing immediate delivery needs.
  • Excellent understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management, and performance optimization.
  • Solid experience with unit testing and a commitment to maintaining high code quality through thoughtful testing practices.
  • Comfort navigating fast-paced environments and collaborating within cross-functional agile teams.
  • Strong eye for design-to-dev fidelity and a passion for creating fluid, responsive user interfaces.


Nice to Have :

  • Full-stack development experience or a strong understanding of backend systems and API design.
  • Experience working with GraphQL APIs and modern data-fetching libraries.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows for web applications.
  • Exposure to modern CSS-in-JS libraries or advanced styling frameworks.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community, fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career - we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: English Communty Leader Program (Remote)
description:
About Fondi

Fondi is a global English learning platform focused on conversation-based learning through live events and communities. We are looking for ESL tutors who want to go beyond teaching and grow their own English-speaking community.


Role description

As a Community Leader, you will build and grow an English learning community by hosting engaging events and guiding members to actively practice speaking in a supportive environment.


Responsibilities

  • Host English conversation events and community activities
  • Build and grow an active learner community
  • Create simple, engaging speaking activities
  • Guide trial members and support their learning journey
  • Work with the Fondi team to improve engagement and retention
  • Maintain consistency in hosting and community interaction


Incentives

  • Incentive-based earnings tied to activity and achievement
  • Rewards based on event consistency, community growth, and engagement
  • Opportunities to unlock higher incentives and VIP-level hosting
  • Personal brand exposure as a global community leader


Requirements

  • ESL tutor or English instructor of English Major Graduated welcome to apply
  • Confident spoken English
  • Comfortable hosting live sessions and leading discussions
  • Interest in community building and learner engagement
  • Reliable and proactive attitude

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Databricks Architect
description:
Databricks Architect / Senior Data Engineer (Contract)

Location: Brazil (Remote – supporting US-based clients)

Contract Length: 6 months


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients. This role will focus on building and optimizing modern lakehouse solutions, with strong ownership of architecture decisions while actively contributing to development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve Databricks lakehouse solutions , following medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) best practices
  • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and SQL
  • Collaborate with US-based stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability across data workloads
  • Contribute to data modeling, data quality, and governance practices
  • Leverage recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric where appropriate, understanding how it complements or integrates with Databricks-based architectures


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark , Databricks , and SQL
  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)
  • Ability to balance architecture leadership with hands-on engineering work
  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and cost optimization in cloud platforms
  • Experience working in hybrid Databricks / Fabric ecosystems

Location: Brazil (Remote – supporting US-based clients)

Contract Length: 6 months


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Databricks Architect who remains highly hands-on as a Data Engineer to support data platform design and delivery for US-based clients. This role will focus on building and optimizing modern lakehouse solutions, with strong ownership of architecture decisions while actively contributing to development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and evolve Databricks lakehouse solutions , following medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold) best practices
  • Act as the technical architect while remaining hands-on in pipeline development , optimization, and troubleshooting
  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, and SQL
  • Collaborate with US-based stakeholders, architects, and delivery teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Optimize performance, cost, and reliability across data workloads
  • Contribute to data modeling, data quality, and governance practices
  • Leverage recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric where appropriate, understanding how it complements or integrates with Databricks-based architectures


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience as a Databricks Architect and/or Senior Data Engineer
  • Proven, hands-on experience implementing medallion architecture in production environments
  • Advanced knowledge of Apache Spark , Databricks , and SQL
  • Experience designing end-to-end data pipelines and lakehouse architectures
  • Recent exposure to Microsoft Fabric (hands-on preferred)
  • Ability to balance architecture leadership with hands-on engineering work
  • Strong English language skills and experience working with US-based clients or teams


Nice to Have

  • Experience in consulting or professional services environments
  • Familiarity with data governance, security, and cost optimization in cloud platforms
  • Experience working in hybrid Databricks / Fabric ecosystems

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

Ambush is a people first company where talented, thoughtful individuals come together to build meaningful products and lasting partnerships. We believe the best work happens when people feel supported, trusted and empowered to bring their full abilities to the table.

Since 2015, because of our people first and long term mindset, we have grown into a partner relied on by some of the best companies in the world. We combine strong engineering, design and strategy with a growing strength in AI to help our clients see what is next and achieve bigger outcomes.

At the heart of everything we do is our team. We collaborate, take risks, lift each other up and take pride in doing work the right way, not settling for a quick makeshift solution. If you join Ambush, you join a group of people who want you to succeed and who show up for each other every day.

We believe in and expect real teamwork, a constant drive to be better, and delivering meaningful long term outcomes that we can be proud of together.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Java developer with strong backend fundamentals and hands-on experience building scalable, reactive systems, ideally in payments or fintech environments.

This role focuses on building and maintaining a high-performance, reactive mid-tier service that powers seamless payment experiences for millions of users.


Responsibilities

  • Develop & Maintain: Design, code, and maintain scalable services within a distributed reactive architecture.
  • Debug & Optimize: Troubleshoot production incidents and optimize JVM memory management and application throughput.
  • Testing & Compliance: Ensure code quality through rigorous testing and adhere to strict PCI compliance security standards.
  • Collaborate: Participate in code reviews, technical planning, and daily stand-ups in English.


Technical Qualifications

  • Core Concepts: Strong grasp of OOP, Design Patterns, and SOLID principles.
  • Functional Programming: Proficiency with functional concepts (Lambdas, Streams, Optionals) and reactive programming models.
  • Concurrency: Experience dealing with race conditions, deadlocks, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.
  • API Development: Strong experience building and consuming RESTful APIs.

title: REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTONÔMO
description:
CONTRATA-SE REPRESENTANTE COMERCIAL AUTÔNOMO – RCA


Indústria Brasileira de cosméticos atuando a 30 anos no mercado nacional, está selecionando Representante Comercial Autônomo (RCA).  –   Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para profissionais de vendas que atuam nos seguimentos: Supermercadista, Especializado em Cosméticos e Farma. Assim como os distribuidores e atacadistas desses seguimentos.


Perfil do Candidato (Requisitos)

  • Experiência Comprovada:  Vivência prévia em vendas no canal alimentar, Especializado em cosméticos e/ou farma (médio ou grande varejo. Distribuidores e atacadistas).
  • Carteira de Clientes:  Carteira ativa no segmento será um forte diferencial.
  • Documentação:  CNPJ ativo e registro no CORE (Conselho Regional dos Representantes Comerciais).
  • Ferramentas de Trabalho:  Veículo próprio e habilitação em dia.
  • Perfil comportamental:  Boa comunicação, organização, autogestão e foco em metas. 


Atribuições do Cargo

  • Visitas e Prospecção:  Realizar rota de vendas para atender clientes e leads dos seguimentos alvo;
  • Gestão de Carteira:  Visitar clientes da base e abrir novos pontos de venda.
  • Negociação:  Realizar cotações, negociações de preços e prazos.
  • Fidelização:  Manter relacionamento ativo e garantir a presença dos produtos nos pontos de vendas.
  • Ações de Trade:  Promover produtos, monitorar estoque e organizar a visibilidade dos produtos no PDV. 


Benefícios e Diferenciais (Sugestões)


  • Remuneração:  Comissionamento atrativo acima da média de mercado, baseado no volume de faturamento.
  • Incentivos:  Premiações por alcance de metas, positivação de clientes e campanhas da indústria.
  • Flexibilidade:  Liberdade de gestão da própria agenda e possibilidade de atuar com portfólios complementares (não exclusivos). 

Sobre a contratação

  • Modelo:  PJ (Pessoa Jurídica), sem vínculo empregatício CLT.

title: Talent Acquisition Manager – NAMER
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to lead and scale recruitment operations for NAMER (North America) clients within an AI/R company structure. This role is responsible for building high-performing talent acquisition strategies to support growth in cutting-edge areas such as Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and advanced software engineering.

You will act as a strategic partner to clients and internal leadership, ensuring hiring excellence, speed, quality, and alignment with business goals in a highly competitive and innovation-driven market.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end talent acquisition strategies for NAMER clients, managing full-cycle recruitment across technical roles within AI/R and technology environments;
  • Partner closely with clients, hiring managers, and executives to understand workforce planning, role requirements, and hiring priorities;
  • Build, manage, and develop high-performing recruiting teams, ensuring delivery excellence, hiring quality, and adherence to SLAs;
  • Design and optimize recruiting processes tailored to the NAMER market, including sourcing strategies, interview frameworks, and candidate experience;
  • Drive hiring initiatives for highly specialized roles, including AI Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Engineers, and Product roles;
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing market insights, talent trends and compensation benchmarks;
  • Ensure compliance with NAMER labor regulations, diversity hiring practices, and internal recruitment standards;
  • Manage recruiting metrics and KPIs;
  • Support employer branding initiatives and represent the company in talent and industry events when applicable;
  • Collaborate with HR, People Operations, and leadership teams to align talent acquisition with broader organizational strategy.


Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Talent Acquisition Manager or Senior Talent Acquisition Partner in technology-driven environments;
  • Strong experience recruiting for the NAMER market, with a primary focus on US hiring practices;
  • Demonstrated success hiring for AI, Machine Learning, Data, Cloud, and software engineering roles;
  • Experience managing recruiting teams and working with multiple stakeholders and clients simultaneously;
  • Deep knowledge of full-cycle recruitment, sourcing strategies, and talent market dynamics in NAMER;
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Experience working in fast-paced, scaling, or consulting environments.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong data-driven mindset

title: Analista de Suporte à Gestão Ágil (SAFe / ARTs)
description:
Sobre nós

A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Sobre a vaga:


Você tem familiaridade com SAFe , gosta de ambientes ágeis complexos e quer apoiar grandes times a entregarem valor de forma estruturada e eficiente? Essa vaga pode ser sua!


O que você vai fazer:


  • Suportar o Release Train Engineer (RTE) na gestão e otimização do fluxo de entrega de valor de um Agile Release Train (ART) ;
  • Apoiar a execução dos Program Increments (PI), participando da preparação, realização e retrospectiva de eventos como PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, PO Syncs, System Demos, Inspect & Adapt ;
  • Elaborar artefatos, atas, relatórios e análises com base em dados extraídos de ferramentas de gestão ágil (burnup, burndown, OKRs, throughput, etc);
  • Apoiar na resolução de impedimentos e no acompanhamento de riscos e dependências;
  • Atuar no acompanhamento financeiro de épicos/features e alimentar sistemas integrados de gestão;
  • Suportar auditorias e controles (como SOX), mantendo a conformidade dos dados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Colaborar com levantamentos de maturidade ágil, DevOps , e apoiar planos de ação de melhoria contínua.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com suporte à gestão em ambientes ágeis estruturados (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe);
  • Conhecimento no framework SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) – desejável certificação ;
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão ágil e análise de dados operacionais (Jira, Excel avançado, etc);
  • Habilidade para comunicação, elaboração de apresentações e condução de reuniões.

title: Cloud Engineer
description:
Job Title:- Azure Cloud Engineer

Location:- Remote (Brazil)


The Senior Engineer – Azure is responsible for engineering cloud automation capabilities for Azure Public Cloud. Azure Senior Engineer will be part of the Cloud Engineering team, which is responsible for building automated provisioning and platforming engineering abstraction for improved developer experience.

The Cloud Engineering team ensures public cloud services are provisioned in a timely manner to Business partners. The Cloud Engineering team also ensures the various public cloud services remain compliant to the highest of security and best practice standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in designing solutions for automated provisioning and compliance of various Azure services using cloud-native capabilities and micro-services-based development.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams in the design and development of various hybrid cloud capabilities. Facilitate design and review sessions between multiple teams, including Application Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Security teams.
  • Create design documents, common patterns that facilitate the acceleration of adoption of various cloud services among application teams
  • Drive innovation through automation of services and capabilities
  • Design, deploy, and maintain complex Azure-based infrastructure and solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security
  • Collaborate with multi-functional teams to gather and analyze requirements for cloud-based projects
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.
  • Design and development of the Self-service Cloud capability delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
  • 3+ years of relevant technology experience
  • 2+ years of public cloud (Azure) experience.
  • Strong expert-level skills of Azure services, including PaaS services
  • Strong hands-on coding skills in Terraform, Groovy to build an automation pipeline for deploying resources, team vending on Azure.
  • Strong background in software engineering
  • Hands-on experience in building solutions using various Azure services
  • Hands-on experience in one or more programming languages preferably Python
  • Hands-on experience developing Cloud agnostic Infrastructure As Code pipeline using Terraform
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA
  • Understanding of micro-services and REST APIs-based application development
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Experience in developing Azure Policies.
  • Experience in deployment of multi-tenant Kubernetes platform
  • Understanding of basic Linux kernel and window server operating system
  • Experience in working with bash, PowerShell scripting.
  • Must be able to solve complex business problems and present recommendations to management effectively.
  • Must have good planning, organizational, analytical, and decision-making skills
  • With little supervision, must be able to define, shape, and drive projects to completion while effectively collaborating strategically with others
  • Strong verbal and writing skills
  • Must be results-driven, a quick learner, and a self-starter

Desired Qualifications

  • Preferred developer/associate/expert certification in Azure

Skills

Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts and infrastructure as code templates for deploying Azure resources and cloud foundation.
  • Create Multi region Cloud foundation and automation for Azure.

  • BA/BS required, preferably in a STEM field
