Microsoft Azure, Terraform, CI/CD

title: Mainframe Project Manager
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um Gerente de Mainframe experiente para liderar e supervisionar projetos complexos de mainframe, garantindo execução bem-sucedida e integração fluida com os processos de negócio. O candidato ideal terá sólida experiência em tecnologias de Mainframe, incluindo z/OS, AS400, JCL, COBOL, REXX e SAS , além de forte vivência em gestão de projetos, gestão de stakeholders, avaliação de riscos e otimização de custos .

Esta função exige habilidades excepcionais de liderança para inspirar equipes, construir relacionamentos com as partes interessadas e impulsionar melhorias de processos.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver planos de projeto abrangentes, definir escopo, estabelecer cronogramas realistas e gerenciar recursos de forma eficaz.
  • Aplicar expertise em tecnologias de Mainframe Broadcom e IBM, incluindo subsistemas, JCL, COBOL e REXX.
  • Construir relacionamentos sólidos com stakeholders-chave, incluindo líderes de negócio, equipes técnicas e usuários finais.
  • Conduzir avaliações de risco, identificar riscos potenciais e desenvolver estratégias de mitigação e planos de contingência.
  • Alocar recursos de forma eficiente, acompanhar despesas e otimizar custos, garantindo o sucesso do projeto.
  • Liderar equipes de projeto, promovendo colaboração e definindo direções claras.
  • Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, assegurando aderência aos planos e cronogramas definidos.
  • Manter canais de comunicação eficazes, gerenciar expectativas dos stakeholders e tratar preocupações de forma ágil.
  • Negociar contratos, acompanhar entregáveis e garantir colaboração eficiente com fornecedores.
  • Avaliar o impacto de migrações de mainframe nos processos e fluxos de trabalho existentes, assegurando transições suaves.
  • Conduzir melhorias de processos e implementar boas práticas de gestão de mudanças.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • z/OS, AS400: Proficiência avançada em sistemas operacionais de mainframe.
  • ITIL, COBOL, JCL, SAS, REXX: Sólido conhecimento prático de linguagens, controle de jobs e scripts em mainframe.
  • Gestão de Projetos e Stakeholders: Forte capacidade de gerenciar projetos de grande escala e engajar stakeholders de forma eficaz.
  • Gestão de Riscos e Relacionamento com Fornecedores: Capacidade de avaliar e mitigar riscos, mantendo parcerias com fornecedores.
  • Orçamento e Previsão Financeira: Experiência em gestão financeira de projetos, otimização de custos e planejamento de recursos.
  • Gestão de Mudanças e Melhoria de Processos: Proficiência na implementação de estratégias de change management e melhorias contínuas.
  • Gestão de Equipes: Fortes habilidades de liderança para orientar, desenvolver e motivar equipes técnicas.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • DB2, IMS, Oracle, MySQL: Experiência em gerenciamento de bancos de dados em ambientes de mainframe.

title: Bilingual DevOps Engineer Remote
description:
DevOps Engineer


Job Description

We are seeking a qualified DevOps Engineer to join our infrastructure team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing Kubernetes-based systems in our on-premises data center, handling everything from bare metal hardware and networking to database administration and application deployment. You will address the unique challenges of operating a private cloud, including optimizing AI model operations, CI/CD pipelines, and integration with Enterprise Java and Python services. This role involves hands-on operation of production data center racks, ensuring flawless performance and scalability for our AI-based applications.


Responsibilities

Design, deploy, and maintain Kubernetes clusters using Helm diagrams for orchestration and configuration management.

Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Git, Jenkins, and related tools to automate testing, integration, and deployment processes. Manage Postgres and NoSQL databases, including performance tuning, backups, scaling, and security configurations. Manage physical hardware in our data center racks, including provisioning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining servers and network components.

Implement, monitor, and manage enterprise Java and Python applications, ensuring compatibility with our AI models and infrastructure.


Skills

Advanced english level. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or systems administration, specializing in Kubernetes and container orchestration. Strong command of Helm for Kubernetes application management. Hands-on experience with Git and Jenkins for developing and managing CI/CD pipelines. Experience administering Postgres databases, including query optimization, replication, and disaster recovery. Knowledge of Enterprise Java and Python programming for application support and scripting. Exceptional mastery of the Linux operating system.

title: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio
description:
Vaga: Supervisor(a) de Estúdio

Local: Escritório Pinheiros – São Paulo/SP | Modelo: 100% Presencial

Nível: Sênior


Chegou a sua hora de liderar a operação que transforma produto em imagem de alta performance!

No e-commerce da Centauro, o estúdio é um pilar estratégico da experiência do cliente. Cada foto e vídeo precisa traduzir qualidade, consistência visual e agilidade, respeitando o Style Guide da marca e os prazos do varejo.

Buscamos um(a) Supervisor(a) de Estúdio para atuar como guardião da eficiência operacional e da excelência técnica, liderando o ciclo completo da produção visual — do planejamento dos calendários à entrega dos resultados — com foco em qualidade, dados e escalabilidade.


Seus desafios no jogo:

  • Atuar como aprovador(a) final da produção técnica e estética de fotos e vídeos, garantindo consistência de luz, cor, enquadramento e styling;
  • Manter e evoluir o Style Guide e os manuais de luz, assegurando padronização e identidade visual da marca;
  • Analisar causas de refações e rejeições, implementando melhorias imediatas nos processos e no set;
  • Planejar e gerenciar o calendário de shootings, coordenando prazos entre modelos, freelancers e times internos;
  • Gerir o fluxo completo das peças no estúdio, desde o recebimento até a entrega final para o e-commerce;
  • Liderar o time técnico (fotografia, vídeo, styling e edição), garantindo produtividade e cumprimento de SLAs;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de produtividade, custos e qualidade para a liderança e diretoria.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Superior completo em Fotografia, Publicidade e Propaganda, Moda, Design, Comunicação, Administração, Produção Audiovisual ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida na liderança de estúdios de moda ou e-commerce de alto volume;
  • Domínio do fluxo de produção visual ponta a ponta (planejamento, captura, edição e entrega);
  • Olhar crítico e técnico para auditoria de qualidade de imagem e vídeo;
  • Forte capacidade de organização, gestão de cronogramas e tomada de decisão sob pressão;
  • Perfil analítico, com facilidade para transformar operação em dados e KPIs;
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times internos, parceiros externos e liderança.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de fluxo e estúdio (Creative Force, ShotFlow, Monday, Airtable ou similares);
  • Vivência em operações de e-commerce de grande escala e alta cadência de produção;
  • Conhecimento em controle de custos e otimização financeira (custo por SKU, refação, horas extras);
  • Noções de pós-produção para melhor integração com o time de edição;
  • Experiência na gestão de freelancers, casting e fornecedores audiovisuais.


O que você encontra por aqui:

  • Atuação em uma operação de estúdio estratégica e de alto impacto no e-commerce;
  • Interface direta com áreas de E-commerce, Produto, Comercial e Diretoria;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado a dados e resultados;
  • Autonomia para implementar melhorias de processo, qualidade e produtividade;
  • Oportunidade de liderar e escalar uma operação visual em constante evolução.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer for a 100% Remote, 6 month +, 1099 contract


No 3rd Party C2Cs Please.


Location: Brazil or Colombia, South America (work remote supporting US based client/project)

Employment Type: Contract Work, 40 hours weekly


100% Requirement: Must have good verbal & written communication (English)


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer IV to lead technical initiatives, tackle complex engineering challenges, and provide mentorship to the team. This role requires expertise in software development, leadership in driving projects, and the ability to design scalable solutions. The ideal candidate will manage the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), contribute to architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive project success.


In This Role You Will:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and deliver project requirements
  • Ensure engineering best practices are followed throughout development
  • Contribute to system architecture and design discussions


Core Competencies for success:

  • Expertise in at least one critical system/service and recognized leadership in that area
  • Proven track record of delivering high-quality software solutions
  • Ability to estimate project costs and resource needs
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills
  • Commitment to continuous learning and innovation


Requirements:

  • Preference for engineers with full-stack proficiency, particularly in Vue.js
  • Proficiency in backend development using Python, SQL, MongoDB and AWS
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing scalable software solutions
  • Strong expertise in software development methodologies and best practices
  • Experience leading teams and managing software projects

  • development technology.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Gainsight, including configuration, data modeling, rules engine, success plans, and reporting (or strong experience integrating Gainsight with Salesforce).

title: Calypso Configuration and Environment Management
description:
Why Luxoft?


Luxoft has one of the world's leading Calypso practice.

We are a top-tier Calypso Partner and a market leader in implementation, integration, upgrade, and migration.

We provide end-to-end project services and have delivered Calypso projects across all major asset classes and sectors including investment banking, asset management, corporate treasury, and insurance.


Our benefits:

  • Comprehensive health & dental insurance (Amil, fully paid, incl. dependents)
  • Remote / home office allowance (monthly)
  • Meal voucher
  • Transportation voucher
  • Childcare / family allowance
  • Savings plan (FGTS)
  • Life & mandatory insurance (fully covered)
  • Profit sharing program


Project Description:

Support and additional build out for a greenfield Calypso instance.


Responsibilities:


- Develop necessary technical solutions for Calypso environments and instance on the cloud as per requirements

- Resolve Calypso environment related issues

- Stabilize Calypso environment with improvements and other services architectural changes

- Establish a comprehensive and integrated approach to defining, setting up, or trouble shooting issues arising from day-to-day activities on greenfield Calypso instance

- Create and deliver assigned projects / tasks and revise as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements

- Competent in managing and establishing methodology and best practice for Calypso technical requirements

- Ensures supporting documents are complete, current, and appropriately stored

- Works closely with relevant business and technology stakeholders to ensure effective and efficient implementation of the project(s)

- Submits status reports to stakeholders; coordinates and provides updates to steering committees

- Collaboration with key functional or business stakeholders to achieve clear outcomes/deliverables in relation to the strategic and transformational book of work

- Manage deliverables ensuring transparency of risks, issues and dependencies that are fully aligned to functional / business owners


You might be acting also as a business analyst as well in order to help the team gathering and writing requirements, acceptance criteria.


Mandatory Skills:

• 5+ years of experience working in Capital Markets and Calypso

• Environment management, support, and optimization experience on Calypso

• Good knowledge of Financial products cross assets

• Proven track record of delivery of implementation / migration projects

• Proven experience in the development of Calypso integrations, reporting, and other technical aspects

- Experience of adherence to governance frameworks / implementation and handover to BAU

• Comprehensive knowledge of trade flow, trading systems and related concepts and technology, including valuation and client/market risk management

• Leadership skills

• Excellent analytical skills, understanding of project life cycles, and ability to act in an entrepreneurial manner to ensure the requirements from the business are gathered in the appropriate manner.

• Proven analytical, planning, problem solving and decision-making skills

• Comfortable with direct communication with all levels of technical and business resources

• Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

• Experience with working in a highly collaborative and dynamic multi-team environment


Nice-to-Have Skills:

• Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment is essential.

• Have a willingness to learn new skills

• Must have attention to detail

• Must have the ability to work independently and also as part of a group


• Experience of Agile practices and processes (e.g. SCRUM, KANBAN)

• Any technical knowledge (Writing simple sql query, be able to read code )

• Conflict management ensuring collaborative outcomes

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy


Languages:

English: B2 Upper Intermediate

Spanish: C2 Proficient


Luxoft is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace.

We show fairness to all throughout our talent acquisition and management process.

title: 销售工程师
description:
Company Overview

Renepoly (Official Website: is a provider of smart microgrid and energy storage solutions in the new energy industry. Our products cover commercial & industrial energy storage and utility-scale energy storage systems, coupled with a self-developed Energy Management System (EMS). We are committed to delivering one-stop clean energy project services for governments, industrial parks, commercial complexes and new energy enterprises.


Equipped with our own manufacturing facility, we boast a solid track record of project delivery, a diversified resource network, as well as an experienced R&D and after-sales team. We have successfully implemented multiple megawatt-scale energy storage and microgrid demonstration projects, with our business scope covering smart energy management, grid peak-shaving, renewable energy grid integration and other fields.


Job Description:

1. Responsible for sales of energy products in Brazil and surrounding markets.

2. Develop new clients, maintain existing relationships, and drive order closures.

3. Manage local warehouse operations and perform basic inventory management.

4. Accompany clients to project sites/warehouse for equipment demonstrations and conduct customer visits.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Are you an experienced Instructional Designer with strong expertise in Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, and Vyond ?


We’re looking for passionate learning professionals to join our large-scale global learning engagement .


Role Overview

This role involves end-to-end instructional design and development of Virtual Instructor-Led (VILT), Instructor-Led (ILT), and Online Learning (OLT/eLearning) programs. You’ll manage the full lifecycle — from defining learning objectives and outlining content to collaborating with SMEs and delivering high-quality courses.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deliver ILTs, VILTs, and OLTs.
  • Create engaging, learner-centric materials using Articulate Storyline, Rise, and Vyond .
  • Lead training design discussions and collaborate closely with clients.
  • Ensure learning outcomes align with business goals and quality standards.
  • Manage multiple priorities while working in a fast-paced, remote, global environment.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proven experience designing and developing ILTs, VILTs, and OLTs.
  • Proficiency with Articulate Storyline, Rise, and Vyond .
  • Excellent communication and client-facing skills.
  • Strong English proficiency (written and spoken).
  • Ability to work independently and align with US business hours .


Desired Experience

  • Experience in large-scale global learning engagements.
  • Background in scaling teams and managing multiple project phases.
  • Minimum 3 years of ID experience .


Engagement Duration: 3 to 18 months (depending on project scope)

⏰ Hours: 40 per week

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Vaga | Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer – Microsoft Stack (SSRS Mandatório)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Engineer / BI Engineer para atuar na engenharia, modelagem e disponibilização de dados corporativos, com forte foco em Microsoft SQL Server e SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS).


Essa é uma posição estratégica, voltada para ambientes corporativos críticos, responsável por relatórios oficiais, operacionais e gerenciais, com atuação próxima a times de backend e áreas de negócio.


Inglês fluente é mandatório.


Responsabilidades


Projetar, desenvolver e manter modelos de dados relacionais e dimensionais (Data Warehouse / Data Marts).


Desenvolver, otimizar e manter stored procedures, views, funções e queries complexas em SQL Server (T-SQL).


Atuar fortemente em performance tuning (índices, execution plans, concorrência).


Desenvolver e manter relatórios corporativos em SSRS, incluindo:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros dinâmicos


Expressions e formatações avançadas


Construir e manter pipelines de dados (ETL) para carga, transformação e consolidação.


Garantir qualidade, consistência, integridade e governança dos dados.


Atuar em parceria com times de backend, entendendo integrações, APIs e fluxos de dados.


Apoiar áreas de negócio na definição de métricas, indicadores e modelos de informação.


Documentar modelos, relatórios e fluxos de dados.


✅ Requisitos Obrigatórios


SQL Server & Data Modeling


Experiência sólida com Microsoft SQL Server.


Domínio de T-SQL avançado.


Forte experiência em modelagem de dados:


Modelagem relacional


Modelagem dimensional (Star Schema / Snowflake)


Fatos, dimensões e histórico (SCD)


SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS)


Experiência obrigatória e comprovada com SSRS.


Criação e manutenção de:


Relatórios paginados


Sub-relatórios


Parâmetros e filtros complexos


Expressions avançadas


Conhecimento em performance, segurança e deploy de relatórios SSRS.


ETL & Integrações


Experiência com ETL / pipelines de dados (preferencialmente SSIS ou equivalente).


Vivência com cargas incrementais, reprocessamentos e tratamento de falhas.


Backend Microsoft


Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft, como:


NET / C# (leitura, manutenção ou desenvolvimento básico)


Integrações de aplicações com SQL Server


Jobs, serviços e processos batch


Capacidade de atuar integrado a times de backend.


Experiência


Perfil Sênior.


Vivência em ambientes corporativos críticos e estruturados.


Inglês fluente.


Diferenciais


Experiência com Azure (Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, App Services).


Conhecimento em Power BI como camada de consumo.


Vivência em Shared Services ou grandes estruturas corporativas.


Experiência em setores regulados (financeiro, indústria, saúde, logística).


Como se candidatar

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Low-Code (Especialista em Automação e n8n)
description:
A Practia está presente em 7 países liderando projetos de automação e transformação digital em grandes clientes. Somos uma das empresas de negócios e tecnologia mais prestigiadas da América Latina com metodologia e equipe técnica especializadas em automação e Hyperautomation.

Possuímos parceria e certificação com as principais plataformas de mercado, atuando como Diamond Partner da UiPath, Platinum Partner da Automation Anywhere, Gold Partner da Microsoft e Silver Partner da IBM. Nossa experiência e vivência em serviços de automação nos garantir, entre diversas premiações, o selo de USN (UiPath Service Network) e LATAM Partner of the Year da UiPath.

Estamos buscando um(a) Desenvolvedor (a) Low-Code (Especialista em Automação e n8n). O profissional será responsável por desenhar, desenvolver e manter fluxos de automação complexos, conectando diferentes plataformas via API para otimizar processos operacionais e de negócio. O foco principal será a construção de ecossistemas integrados e escaláveis utilizando o n8n como orquestrador principal.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Planejamento de Workflows: Desenhar a arquitetura lógica de automações antes da implementação, garantindo eficiência e tratamento de erros.
  • Desenvolvimento no n8n: Criar, testar e publicar fluxos de automação utilizando nós nativos e personalizados.
  • Integração de Sistemas: Consumir e expor APIs (REST/JSON) para garantir o fluxo de dados entre ferramentas (CRMs, ERPs, Bancos de Dados, IA, etc).
  • Manipulação de Webhooks: Configurar e gerenciar gatilhos em tempo real para disparar ações baseadas em eventos externos.
  • Manutenção e Otimização: Monitorar execuções, realizar debugging de fluxos existentes e refatorar automações para ganho de performance.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Domínio de n8n: Experiência sólida na criação de workflows complexos, uso de expressões, variáveis de ambiente e nodes binários.
  • Conexão com APIs: Conhecimento profundo em autenticação (OAuth2, API Keys, Basic Auth) e métodos HTTP (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH).
  • Webhooks: Experiência prática no recebimento e envio de dados via webhooks.
  • Lógica de Programação: Forte capacidade analítica para estruturar condicionais, loops e transformações de dados.


Conhecimentos Adicionais (Diferenciais)


  • JavaScript: Capacidade de criar funções personalizadas dentro do n8n (Code Node) para manipulação complexa de objetos e arrays.
  • Python: Conhecimento para scripts de automação, processamento de dados (Pandas/NumPy) ou integração com modelos de IA.
  • SQL: Noções básicas para consulta e inserção de dados em bancos como PostgreSQL ou MySQL.
  • Ferramentas de IA: Experiência integrando automações com OpenAI (GPT), Anthropic ou modelos locais.


Perfil Desejado


  • Proatividade para buscar soluções documentadas em APIs de terceiros.
  • Organização para documentar os fluxos criados.
  • Foco em escalabilidade (pensar em como o workflow se comporta com 10 ou 10.000 execuções).



Contratação PJ.

Vaga prioritariamente remota, podendo ocorrer visitas eventuais no cliente e/ou escritório da Practia.

title: AWS-Python Production Support Enginner
description:
AWS-Python Production Support Engineer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Full Remote

Experience: Seniority Level

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues across environments, including pipeline failures and data inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and evolve schema-driven YAML/JSON configurations for distribution and exhibition platforms.
  • Support operational workflows by updating internal Python automation scripts.
  • Perform database-level investigations to validate data integrity and confirm fixes.
  • Work through PR-based change management with clear documentation and regression verification.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth delivery operations.
  • Apply observability and log analysis techniques to trace failures and extract actionable insights.
  • Ensure compliance with schema validation and maintain configuration hygiene.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • YAML/JSON (production-grade): Safe authoring/refactoring, strict structure, and change hygiene.
  • Git + PR workflow: Clean diffs, review discipline, conflict handling, and controlled promotions.
  • Observability & log analysis: Tracing failures across pipeline stages, correlating identifiers, and extracting actionable signals from logs/metrics.
  • Schema/validation mindset: Interpreting schema/tooling errors and keeping configs compliant.
  • Python: Debugging and adjusting existing scripts/automation; implementing targeted fixes safely.
  • Databases (SQL): Querying to investigate production issues, validate data integrity, and confirm outcomes.
  • Production support fundamentals: Incident triage, root-cause analysis, mitigations, and regression verification.
  • Jinja templating: Understanding template-driven generation and making safe, minimal changes.


Optional Knowledge

  • Media Supply Chain fundamentals: Deliverables, packaging concepts, metadata hierarchies, locale conventions, and downstream dependency impacts.
  • Advanced mapping/config patterns (conditional/switch/lookup/padding; robust globals/locals usage).
  • CI/automation improvements (linting/formatting, pre-validation checks, regression harnesses).
  • Partner operations context (common rejection patterns, partner-specific exceptions, operational playbooks).
  • Communication in incident/PR contexts (concise updates, change summaries, and requirement translation).


Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on experience in production support for large-scale delivery platforms.
  • Strong understanding of schema-driven configuration management and automation workflows.


Does this sounds like something you'd like to do? Apply and attach your resume in English and we'll take it from here.

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Engineer - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:
We’re looking for a skilled Data Engineer with hands-on experience in Apache Airflow to join our data team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and workflows that support our analytics and data-driven products.

  • Develop , schedule, and monitor data pipelines using Apache Airflow.
  • Collaborate with data analysts, scientists, and engineering teams to ensure reliable data delivery.
  • Optimize ETL processes for performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Maintain and improve data architecture, ensuring data integrity and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and performance bottlenecks.

What we are looking for:

  • A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field.
  • Curiosity: You are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You get involved in the entire value chain, which can include front-end, back-end, big data infrastructure, ML models…
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: GCP Data Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for GCP Data Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Proficiency in BigQuery, Dataflow (Apache Beam), Cloud Storage, and Pub/Sub

Experience with SQL, Oracle Database, and PostgreSQL

Knowledge of orchestration using Cloud Composer (Airflow)

Hands-on experience with CI/CD applied to data pipelines (Git, Terraform)

Experience with cloud cost and performance optimization

GCP certifications

Knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE) and APIs on GCP

Experience with Machine Learning pipelines (Vertex AI, AI Platform)

Previous involvement with Data Mesh and distributed architectures

Understanding of Data Lake layers

Knowledge of batch and streaming processing

Experience with data modeling (relational, dimensional, and NoSQL)

Design and implement data architectures on GCP using services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Composer, among others.

Develop and optimize scalable, high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines.

Ensure data quality, integrity, and security end-to-end.

Create and maintain data models aligned with business needs.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and software engineers to support advanced analytics and machine learning use cases.

Automate ingestion, transformation, and data delivery processes.

Monitor and optimize cost and performance of GCP resources.

Implement best practices for DataOps and Data Governance.


BigQuery, Dataflow, AlloyDB, APIGee (focus in GCP)

What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

What do we offer?

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

International experience opportunity

title: Gerente Soluções SAP
description:
A Atos é uma líder global em transformação digital, com cerca de 94.000 colaboradores e uma receita anual de aproximadamente €11 bilhões de euros. Número um na Europa em cibersegurança, nuvem e computação de alto desempenho, o Grupo oferece soluções personalizadas de ponta a ponta para todos os setores em 69 países. Pioneira em serviços e produtos de descarbonização, a Atos está comprometida com um ambiente digital seguro e descarbonizado para seus clientes. A Atos é uma SE (Societas Europaea) e está listada na Euronext Paris.


Gerente Soluções – SAP


Local: Híbrido 2 vezes por semana em São Paulo (Capital).

Horário: 09:00 – 18:00.


Buscamos Gerente Soluções SAP Sênior, para integrar nosso time de pré-vendas. O profissional atuará em apoio direto à área comercial, definindo estratégias técnicas, coordenando entregas e garantindo propostas competitivas e aderentes às necessidades dos clientes.


Responsabilidades:

  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com a equipe de vendas para identificar oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias SAP para os clientes;
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de produtos para clientes potenciais, destacando benefícios e funcionalidades das soluções SAP;
  • Avaliar e compreender os requisitos SAP dos clientes e oferecer recomendações de soluções adequadas;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de engenharia e desenvolvimento para garantir que as soluções oferecidas atendam às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Elaborar custeio e precificação de soluções SAP, garantindo competitividade e adequação ao mercado;
  • Compreender e gerenciar o ciclo de venda, desde a identificação de oportunidades até o fechamento de contratos;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e comerciais para empresas públicas e privadas, garantindo o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios e das especificações do cliente;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de propostas técnicas e documentos de resposta a RFPs/RFIs;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias em SAP e disseminar conhecimento na equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em SAP, preferencialmente com atuação em pré-venda;
  • Experiência em elaboração de propostas para empresas públicas e privadas;
  • Atuação comprovada como mandatário de delivery (responsável pela coordenação/entrega de projetos) ou Consultor SAP nas áreas logística (MM/SD/WM/Transportation) ou financeira (FI/CO), com forte conhecimento dos processos de negócio;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de integração de sistemas, gestão de dados e conformidade regulatória em ambientes SAP;
  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem/hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) em ambientes de nuvem pública;
  • Vivência com parceiros tecnológicos e integradores no mercado brasileiro;
  • Formação superior em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação, Administração, Contabilidade, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas será diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação) — uso cotidiano;
  • Certificações relevantes em SAP serão consideradas diferencial;
  • Capacidade para trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa;
  • Habilidade para comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara a públicos técnicos e executivos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens conforme necessário.


Benefícios:

  • Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação;
  • Plano de saúde extensível a cônjuge e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Programa de remuneração variável;
  • Auxílio creche - conforme regras sindicais da localidade;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Convênio com farmácias – descontos em medicamentos;
  • Previdência Privada com seguro de vida adicional
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Empréstimo Consignado (após 1 ano de empresa);
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas);
  • Política de Subsídios para Pós-graduação, MBAs e Certificações (A Atos apoia o seu desenvolvimento, subsidiando financeiramente ações externas);
  • Speexx (curso online de até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)
  • Programa de treinamentos internos e externos;
  • Universidade corporativa (E-learning com milhares de cursos disponíveis gratuitamente);
  • Espaço Saúde (suporte com atendimento médico - presencial ou online - para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida);
  • Terapia online;
  • Programa de acompanhamento à gestante (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras ou cônjuges);
  • Programa Minha Nova Parceria de Confiança (para colaboradores e cônjuges. Válido também para filhos adotivos) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro;
  • Day off no seu aniversário;
  • Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos);
  • Bônus de indicação para nossas vagas (conforme política interna);
  • Jubileu (premiação personalizada por tempo de empresa);
  • Accolade (Programa de reconhecimento).


Aviso de Diversidade

Entendemos a diversidade como um fator valioso. Todas as nossas oportunidades são Afirmativas para Pessoas com Deficiência.

Valorizamos a diversidade independentemente de identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, etnia, idade, deficiência, nacionalidade ou qualquer outro aspecto.


Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

title: 销售经理
description:
Professional competence (Job related) 专业能力 （与工作相关）:

  • 3年及以上食品配料或添加剂行业销售经验，有亲水胶体相关从业经验者优先；
  • 熟悉亲水胶体（卡拉胶、琼脂、复配食品添加剂等）产品应用技术，具备与客户针对亲水胶体应用技术方面进行沟通交流；
  • 语言：除本国母语外，要求英语流利，中文沟通者更佳；
  • 良好的书面及口头表达能力，熟练使用常用办公软件。
  • 有较强的商务谈判能力


  • At least 3 years and above sales experiences in food ingredients or food additives industry,working experience in hydrocolloid industry is preferred.
  • Be familiar with the application technology of hydrocolloid, and have the ability to develop project with customer by using carrageenan, agar, konjac gum and blended solutions.

（3）Language: In addition to native language, English fluency is required, Chinese communicator is preferred

（4）Good written and oral communication ability, proficiency with office software.

（5）Good commercial negotiation ability


主要职责：

  • 负责市场开发、客户开发和维护和销售管理等工作。
  • 负责所属区域的产品宣传、推广和销售,完成销售的任务指标。
  • 制定自己的销售计划，并按计划拜访客户和开发新客户。
  • 搜集与寻找客户资料，建立客户档案。
  • 做好销售合同的签订、履行与管理等相关工作，以及协调处理各类市场问题。
  • 具有团队协作精神，有效利用内部、外部资源完成销售目标。


Key Accountabilities

(1) Responsible for market development, customer development maintenance and sales management.

(2) Responsible for product publicity, promotion and sales in the region, and complete the sales target.

(3) Make your own sales plan, visit customers and develop new customers as planned.

(4) Collect and find customer information, and establish customer files.

(5) Well management of sales contract signing, implementation, and with good coordination and deal with various market issues.

(6) Have good teamwork spirit, and effectively use internal and external resources to achieve sales targets.
company: 绿新(福建)食品有限公司

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Our client is a U.S.-based company that provides technical expertise, testing, and certification services to the global food and agricultural industry. Their mission is to ensure food safety, quality, and sustainability across international supply chains.


They are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software Engineer to design, develop, and optimize the core APIs and data services powering their flagship SaaS platform. This role focuses requires expertise in TypeScript/JavaScript, C#/.NET and Azure cloud development practices. You will also help set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and ensure the software meets the highest standards for performance, scalability, and security.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Design and develop RESTful APIs and backend services using .NET/C# on Azure Web Apps
  • Model and manage SQL data structures (Azure SQL) to support complex engineering workflows.
  • Build responsive, accessible UI screens in HTML and TypeScript, leveraging the Webix control platform to deliver clean, maintainable front-end components
  • Implement security best practices including IAM role configuration, least-privilege access, and API authentication/authorization.
  • Write and maintain test automation to ensure code quality and reduce regression risk.
  • Participate in DevOps practices including CI/CD pipeline maintenance, infrastructure-as-code (YAML), and application monitoring using telemetry tools Application Insights and KUSTO language.
  • Leverage AI-powered assistants and developer tools to reduce repetitive work, improve code quality, and accelerate delivery.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with international teams including Product Managers, UX designers, test engineers, and DevOps.
  • Mentor team members on best practices in software architecture, design patterns, and coding standards.
  • Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to established guidelines.


This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive. Employees may be asked to perform additional tasks as required, that may or may not be related to their primary duties.


Required Qualifications:


  • BA/BS degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing SaaS applications.
  • 2+ years in .NET/C# for developing RESTful APIs.
  • 2+ years Web API, JSON, and TypeScript consuming RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency in version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with SQL databases such as SQL Server / Oracle
  • Ability to work independently in short delivery cycles with minimal rework.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.


This is a CRT Role at R$18,000/month + Annual Bonus

description:

· UiPath Certification

· Fluent English

· Experience working with .NET, Java, Angular, or COBOL systems

Additional Information

· Location: Brazil.

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Full Stack Engineer PHP/Javascript
description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer


Role Type: Full-Time Regular Employment

Setup: Fully Remote

Duration: Open-ended, Long term

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: US Eastern Time (EST)

Rate: USD 3,500-4,000 per month


Position Overview:


The Senior Full Stack Engineer will play a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining our client’s core business applications. We are looking for a true systems analyst who thrives on solving complex business challenges and translating them into robust, scalable, and high-performing technical solutions. This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. The ideal candidate should have strong foundational skills in vanilla JavaScript , pure PHP , and writing code from scratch without the support of abstractions or libraries.


You will work across both the front-end and back-end of modern web applications using PHP, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL, and React , collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver efficient and maintainable systems. Strong English communication skills are essential for interacting with internal stakeholders, product owners, and developers across global teams.


What You Will Do:


The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Write clean, well-structured, and well-tested code without depending heavily on frameworks, ensuring clarity and maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for speed, scalability, and long-term stability.
  • Participate in architectural discussions and contribute to decisions involving raw code structure, system design, and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure the product is performant, reliable, and aligned with business goals.
  • Stay updated with evolving best practices in no-framework development , JavaScript, PHP, SQL, and full stack engineering.
  • Mentor and guide junior developers, especially in understanding code fundamentals and building solutions without relying on frameworks.
  • Prepare and maintain clear and detailed technical documentation.


What You Will Bring:


  • Proven ability to write clean, well-documented, and well-tested pure code in both PHP and JavaScript (examples may be requested).
  • Strong knowledge of vanilla JavaScript , DOM manipulation, event handling, and building functionality without libraries.
  • Expertise in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL , with hands-on experience designing and maintaining relational databases.
  • Proficiency with React or modern front-end frameworks, while still having the ability to work without them when needed.
  • Experience with object-oriented programming (OOP) and design patterns.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
  • Strong English verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working in agile, team-based environments.
  • Knowledge of the logistics, supply chain, or transportation industry is a plus.
  • A strong sense of ownership, attention to detail, and a passion for writing beautiful code.
  • Comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced, globally distributed environment.


Minimum Qualifications:


  • 10+ years of experience in full stack development.
  • Hands-on experience with pure PHP , vanilla JavaScript , MySQL , PostgreSQL , SQL , and React in production environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to build solutions from scratch without relying on frameworks.
  • Proven experience leading complex projects from concept to deployment.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC principles and agile methodologies.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).

This individual must be highly comfortable working with pure code without relying on frameworks , especially in areas where the company prefers clean, raw implementations. What You Will Do:


The individual in this position will be expected, on a regular basis, to:

  • Design, develop, and maintain back-end functionality for enterprise-level business applications using PHP in pure form , avoiding unnecessary frameworks when required.
  • Build and enhance interactive, responsive front-end interfaces using vanilla JavaScript , along with React when applicable.
  • Develop and optimize databases using MySQL and PostgreSQL , including schema design, complex queries, indexing, stored procedures, and performance tuning.

title: Engenheiro de IA (LLM)
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento em LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT (40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);
